algorithm: {This algorithm calculates the remaining capacity in each bin after placing the given item, assigns higher priority to bins with smaller remaining capacity (tightest fit) and sets the priority to negative infinity for bins that cannot fit the item.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    return np.where(remaining >= 0, -remaining, -np.inf)

algorithm: {For each bin, compute the priority as the negative of the remaining capacity after placing the item into the bin if the bin has sufficient capacity to hold the item, otherwise assign a very low priority value so that bins resulting in smaller leftover space have higher priority scores}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    priorities[valid_mask] = -(bins[valid_mask] - item)
    return priorities
